title: Secondary Education, B.S. -- Mathematics Teaching Option (Behrend)
notes: Pattern B (genuinely different subject area from University Park's Secondary Education B.S., SECED-2026.json, which models the Biology Teaching Option) -- confirmed 2026-08-27 by reading Behrend's own bulletin page for this major. Behrend's Secondary Education B.S. offers only ONE certification option at the Erie campus: Mathematics Teaching (the bulletin's own option-availability table explicitly marks every other option -- Biology, Chemistry, Earth and Space Science, English, Environmental Education, General Science, Physics, Social Studies -- as 'University Park only'). This is therefore a different subject area entirely from the UP plan already in this repo, not a campus variant of the same option, so it is genuinely Pattern B even though the two plans share the same major title and many of the same College-of-Education common requirements (CI/EDPSY/HDFS/SPLED courses). Real 'Requirements for the Major' confirmed verbatim via direct fetch of the bulletin's own tables (2026-08-27): Common Requirements (all options, 45cr) -- CI 280(3), CI 295(2), CI 495C(3), CI 495E(15), EDPSY 14(3), HDFS 239(3), SPLED 400(4), SPLED 403B(3), CI 492 or EDPSY 422(3), 3cr GH Literature Selection, 3cr of EDTHP 115/115A/400-level EDTHP; Mathematics Teaching Option (57cr) -- Prescribed: MATH 140/141/220/310/311W/312/414/471, MTHED 411/412W/427; Additional: (MATH 231&232 OR MATH 230), (MATH 435 OR 470), (MATH 436 OR 441), (MATH 415 OR STAT 401), 3cr MTHED from the program list; Supporting: 6cr from 400-level MATH or MTHED. An earlier, more detailed 8-semester Suggested-Academic-Plan fetch of this same bulletin page produced an apparently-garbled extra line ('STAT 301 or 318') that does not appear anywhere in the verified, re-fetched verbatim Requirements-for-the-Major table and was NOT included here -- treated as a likely OCR/table-extraction artifact rather than a real requirement, per the 'never fabricate' rule (better to omit a suspect line than encode an unverifiable one). Modeled MATH 230 (not the MATH 231-and-232 pair) for the 'Calculus of Several Variables' requirement, and left the 3cr 'MTHED from the program list' and the two 3cr '400-level MATH or MTHED' Supporting Course slots as open_electives restricted to the plan's own MATH/MTHED departments -- no Behrend-published enumerated list exists for either. Modeled the 3cr EDTHP requirement with the bulletin's own three real named alternatives (EDTHP 115, EDTHP 115A, or any of the real cataloged 400-level EDTHP courses) rather than a generic slot, since all of those codes are already confirmed real and cataloged. Reused the same real, university-wide GH 'Literature Selection' match-regex already verified and wired for SECED-2026.json (and Elementary/Early Childhood Education) since it's not campus-specific. Total program credits per the bulletin's own detailed SAP: 134-136 (this plan's own semester sum is 133, close given several GenEd/overlap credits aren't independently reconstructable from public sources -- same 'didn't fully reconcile' precedent already documented in HIST-2026.json). Semester 8 is CI 495E alone (15cr, student teaching) per the bulletin's own explicit note that 'no additional coursework [is] permitted during Student Teaching' -- same convention as SECED-2026.json's own final semester.
